title: Math Camp
text: A two-week review that prepares incoming PhD students for the O’Neill quantitative sequence, organized into ten one-day modules. Modules 1–6 cover mathematics; modules 7–10 continue into probability, statistics, and an introduction to econometrics. A third component — the computing workflow used throughout the program — runs alongside.

title: Math Camp
text:
The daily rhythm
Each module is designed to take one day. SPEA 270 is reserved for you for both weeks — you are highly encouraged to work through camp together.



10:00 a.m.
Meet in SPEA 270; work through the module’s lecture notes together


Midday
Attempt the problem set on your own — honest attempts before looking anything up


1:00 p.m.
Reconvene to compare answers and discuss


Following day
Turn in your handwritten problem set (Prof. Ortega’s mailbox, or scan to alorte@iu.edu)



Problem sets are ungraded — they are where the learning happens. The final exam is in person, without AI tools, and is graded.
